primary: Loaded-segment acceleration RMS; all load/road cases retained; also travel, tire, force and contact.
selection: Training/action-validation data and development roads only. Held-out roads frozen until model selection.
mass_update: Causal prior-sample estimate; no true change time available to controller.
baseline: Same policy with mass input fixed at 300 kg; also previous policy and matched MPC.
objective: Improve actual control and mass-dependent action accuracy, never maximize relative gain by degrading the fixed-input baseline.
